method: M4 Procedural 2D Compositor + existing runtime DoorLayer motion

material.note: Moving leaves are deliberately darker than the accepted wall family so the door reads as a separate moving mechanism without becoming a focal neon element.

keyVariant.presentation: narrow semantic colour marker on otherwise normal graphite door

qa.closed: two 64px halves meet cleanly at center; 5px total visible thickness; final approach decelerates with no overshoot
qa.open: leaves retract 104% and are clipped exactly at the 64x128 door aperture; no leaf pixels, guide rails or status text remain in the wall/open state
qa.occlusion: leaf-clip overflow hidden is authoritative; z-index ordering is secondary protection only
qa.motion: opening remains 520ms; closing uses 650ms monotonic soft-close easing and explicit translate(0) endpoint
